paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Wait-k Policy
model_annotation: This figure illustrates the relationship between average lagging and BLEU score for three different configurations. The horizontal axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)," is scaled linearly from 0 to 8 and displays integer tick labels at each unit. The vertical axis, labeled "BLEU," is scaled linearly from 20 to 30 with tick labels at increments of 2. Three distinct line series are depicted, each representing a different configuration, with a dashed line style; the "Consistency-CE" series is shown in blue with circular markers, the "Consistency-Bi +sampling" series is shown in orange with triangular markers, and the "Consistency-Bi +beam" series is shown in green with square markers. The "Consistency-CE" series begins at approximately 20.5 BLEU and increases to approximately 28.5 BLEU. The "Consistency-Bi +sampling" series starts around 21.5 BLEU and increases to approximately 28.8 BLEU. The "Consistency-Bi +beam" series begins at approximately 23.8 BLEU and rises to approximately 29.1 BLEU. A legend is provided below the plot, which indicates that the blue line with circles represents "Consistency-CE," the orange line with triangles represents "Consistency-Bi +sampling," and the green line with squares represents "Consistency-Bi +beam."
